name: 案笺
subtitle: 案件、日程与材料的本地工作台
promotionalText: 用时间轴串起案件脉络，把节点、材料、相关人员和收支关联起来。在设备上整理工作，无需注册或登录。
description:
案笺是一款面向独立执业律师及其他案件资料整理者的本地工作台。

案件脉络
按状态查找案件，在时间轴中查看关键节点、待办、日程、记录、材料和收支。为一审、开庭等节点添加属性，关联已有对象或新建对象，梳理案件进展。

材料与文档
通过系统文件选择器导入材料，按案件和文件夹归档。新建、编辑本地文本或 Markdown 文档，给对象添加标签及重要程度。PDF、图片和音频可在应用内预览，材料可导出副本。

录音与归档
点击开始后使用麦克风，录音可暂停、继续并保存为案件材料。iOS 锁屏、后台和系统音频中断会暂停录音，返回前台后可继续。

人员与机构
整理当事人、律师、法院等案件相关人员和机构，记录本案身份并关联其他对象。

费用与日程
记录案件收入、支出、约定费用和凭据，查看收支构成；用日程与待办安排工作。当前 iOS 版本的日程在应用内查看，不提供系统通知提醒。

外观与本地数据
支持浅色、深色与跟随系统，强调色随背景调整。无需注册或登录，案件、材料和录音保存在本机，不上传给开发者；没有广告或开发者云同步服务。本机自动备份不等同于设备外备份，当前 iOS 版本不支持整份工作区的设备外备份导出与恢复。卸载应用会移除本机应用数据。

案笺用于整理用户自行提供的信息，不提供法律咨询或代理服务。
keywords: 案件,律师,材料,日程,待办,工作记录,录音,费用,本地,文件归档

reviewNotes:
Guideline 2.1 — Additional information
App: Anjian (案笺), version 1.7.5, build 21.1.

1. Physical-device demonstration
Video: [PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VIDEO_URL]
Device / iOS: [DEVICE_MODEL] / [IOS_VERSION]
The video starts on the Home Screen and shows launching the submitted build and its main workflow.

2. Purpose and audience
Anjian is a local productivity workspace for individual lawyers and other people organizing their own case-related work. It brings case progress, key events, tasks, documents, recordings, people/organizations, and expense records together, helping users find scattered materials and understand what needs attention. It is available to individual users, not restricted to employees of a particular business.

3. Access and main-feature instructions
No registration, login, demo account, activation, subscription, or purchase is required. The UI is Simplified Chinese. On first launch, tap Get started (开始使用) on the welcome screen.
- Open Cases (案件), tap New (新建), enter a fictional name, and tap Create case (创建案件).
- The case tabs are Timeline (脉络), Materials (材料), People (人员), and Expenses (费用). The Timeline combines records and key nodes, which can have custom properties and links to other case objects.
- Tap Create (创建) > Key node (关键节点), enter a name such as First instance (一审), and save. Open the node to add properties or link objects.
- In Materials, tap Add materials (添加材料) and choose a file from Files. Files are copied into local app storage. Optional sample: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/limushu/new_hm/main/docs/app-store/review-samples/sample-case-notes.txt . Users can also select their own PDF, image, text or audio files.
- Tap Recording (录音) > Start recording (开始录音), allow microphone access, record a short sample, finish and save it. The audio appears in this case's materials. Recording pauses on backgrounding, locking or audio interruption and can be resumed in the foreground.
- In People, tap Add people/organizations (添加人员或机构), choose Person/Court/Judge/Organization, then select an existing local record or create one and add it to the case. The case role is optional. In Expenses, tap Record entry (记一笔) to enter an amount/category; the chart summarizes records.
- Settings (设置) includes the offline Privacy Policy (隐私政策).
Users create/import private local content. There is no public publishing, community feed or user-to-user messaging. There are no account or public-content reporting/blocking flows, or paid features, to demonstrate.

4. External services, tools and platforms
Core features run locally using Tauri/WebKit, React, SQLite and bundled PDF.js. iOS microphone/audio and Files/document-picker services provide recording and file import/export. Optional iCloud Drive or other Files providers are chosen and managed by the user, not a developer-operated cloud service. GitHub hosts public support/privacy pages opened on request. There are no external case-data providers, authentication, payments, ads, analytics, AI or speech-transcription services in this build. Case content and recordings are not uploaded to the developer.

5. Regional behavior
The build has no region-based feature or content gates; the same functionality is provided across enabled storefronts. The current UI language is Simplified Chinese.

6. Regulated services and content rights
This is a productivity/record-keeping tool. It does not provide legal advice, legal representation, lawyer matching, financial/payment services, or access to court systems, and does not claim court/government affiliation or professional accreditation. Users supply their own records and files. Built-in examples, review samples and screenshots use fictional material created for demonstration, not protected third-party case files or licensed legal databases.
